title: Dynamical dimension and shift embeddability without the marker property
summary: We study the aperiodic inverse-limit system constructed in our earlier work as an example of a finite-mean-dimensional dynamical system without the marker property. We prove that its mean dimension and Meyerovitch's dynamical dimension are both equal to $N$. Despite the absence of the marker property, the system admits an equivariant topological embedding into the cubical shift with alphabet dimension $3N+2$.
